name: Guangdong PAK Corporation Co., Ltd.
summary: Operating within China, Guangdong PAK Corporation Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse range of lighting products and complete solutions. Its extensive catalog encompasses specialized lighting for commercial, engineering, outdoor, residential, intelligent, educational, office, and healthcare environments. Additionally, the company supplies electrical appliances for light sources, ventilation products, and various luminaires. The firm was established in 1991 and maintains its headquarters in Guangzhou, China.
